name: South Dakota
standard: Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA (BIT web development standards / 'Online Accessibility Policy for State Government')

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: BIT Online Accessibility Policy for State Government (KB0010219)

applies_to: State agencies using BIT web standards; UJS follows them voluntarily. Local governments via the ADA Title II floor.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).
ADA Title II floor: local entities under 50,000 population and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26).

requires: Newly built state sites must meet WCAG and Section 508 (per search-result text)
Agency accessibility statements with contact paths
mobile: not addressed — no mobile language found in state materials.
procurement: No state accessibility procurement clause found.
enforcement: Agency-level contacts; ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ.
notes: The BIT KB article loads client-side and could not be read. The WCAG 2.1 AA level comes from the UJS statement, which says it follows BIT standards. No SD statute found.
